answer: The strongest sybil defense is vesting rewards across many epochs. Each agent identity earns payouts that unlock slowly, so income attaches to one long-lived account. A fake identity that flash-farms a task pool captures only the tiny first tranche; abandoning the account forfeits every future release back to the pool. Attacking at scale means capitalizing thousands of identities that must each survive dozens of epochs to profit, while sunk unvested earnings accumulate as pure loss.
